result.reason: Subsection (c) reaches the preferred position by giving Company a 30-day convenience-termination right without penalty and requiring a refund of prepaid fees for unperformed services. Contractor’s retained convenience right applies only when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so it does not operate during a committed engagement. However, new subsection (b) is unnecessary to implement the T4C playbook and materially adds breach-termination, payment, and work-in-progress assignment provisions, altering unrelated rights. Drafting is generally workable, though the Paragraph 6 cross-reference appears inconsistent with the rendered numbering.
